description: This bar chart illustrates quality scores for two categories, IFD and DELTA, with two sets of values represented for each category. The horizontal axis, labeled “Quality Scores”, displays the categories IFD and DELTA in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Scores”, represents a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70 with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each category, there are two bars: a shorter, orange bar labeled “AvgGap” and a taller, blue bar labeled “AvgRun”. The AvgGap bar for IFD reaches a value of approximately 41.90, while the AvgRun bar for IFD reaches 63.98. For DELTA, the AvgGap bar reaches a value of approximately 37.91, and the AvgRun bar reaches 67.64. Additionally, a dashed horizontal line is present at a value of 40, labeled “Base AvgGap”, and a dotted horizontal line is present at a value of 60, labeled “Base AvgRun”. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation, and no annotations are present.
